question: Does an analytic full-coordinate derivative follow the actual causal jump-aware finite-grid task value, including delayed left/right successors, and drive a real fixed-target parameter update?
scope: Bounded finite-grid research derivative qualification for15declared trainable task coordinates plus continuous query input inside interpolation cells. Not full financial He-Xiong, continuum free-boundary derivatives, neural quality, exact continuous stopping, native production, GPU or energy adoption.
chart: Costs/risk/slope use positive exponential; M rows softmax; reward base=sigmoid(beta), amplitude=(1-base)*sigmoid(share). Strictly representable interior required, no clipping/floors. Both row logits retained, with explicit gauge-null derivative tests.
time_contract: Actual R18 API is a time lattice. T/rho changes off that lattice reject; changes of integer lag are topology/model changes, not a zero ordinary gradient. Admission left/right values are exposed, ordinary derivatives at these jumps are not fabricated.
canonical_primal: Call the unchanged actual R18 jump_solver.solve. Scoped sys.setprofile return callback binds its exact code object, captures required left-limit locals, checks shapes/first-left/output-array identity and restores prior profiler in finally. No alternative copied primal generates qualification values.
jump_tangent: Analytic chart and payoff partials; solve active linear equations for every coordinate with actual left limit. Reset derivative includes M, fee, carry, interpolation position and delayed value Jacobian. At k*rho use separate left/right derivative and new-reset max.
positive_reference_tangent: Differentiate actual positive Gaussian-image/hat integral analytically via density*(z^2-1) for log_sigma; propagate all other payoff/cost/reset/chart coordinates through the actual reference max program.
independent_references: Centered parameter finite differences of actual unchanged primal/reference, both registered step sizes retained
Independently assembled global all-time sparse equations and independent coordinate RHS, including auxiliary left-limit unknowns and right-jump equations
Independent Fourier heat/tangent ODE of linear-hat alias modes versus Gaussian density tangent
coverage: All15coordinates in all6registered profiles attempted for both engines; per-coordinate nonvacuous stable-branch coverage required, all changed branches/errors retained. Independent global sparse check on all3coarse profiles; every actual left/right admission and time-state covered by each aggregate comparison.
heat_ode: DOP853 rtol2e-12/atol2e-14,7alias modes -3..3 with linear-hat sinc-squared initial coefficients; omitted-mode log decay recorded, no project density tangent used in ODE RHS
nonsmooth_cases: Construct exact first-admission STOP/new-RESET tie from terminal values; ordinary Jacobian rejects, critical-cone directional derivatives compared on both sides
Set WAITcost=max finite reflected Lg to construct biactive left-LCP row; solve directional complementarity, no straight-through hard-action derivative
Reset quality exactly on interpolation knot: ordinary rejects and one-sided moving-interpolation tangents checked
Query state on interpolation knot exposes left/right slopes and Clarke interval instead of a unique state gradient
Off-lattice horizon/recovery changes reject and profiler restoration is verified on errors

training.classification: Fixed-physical-input/fixed-teacher-value-target calibration smoke, not neural quality or independent learning gain
training.target_rule: Actual canonical teacher values generated once, then bytes/hash fixed for all20student steps; actor/model updates never change physical inputs or teacher targets
training.acceptance: Reevaluate actual canonical objective after every candidate; accept only nonincreasing loss. Keep all attempted costs/steps. No derivative of actions.

failure_policy: Create-only output, preserve failures/logs, no result-driven tolerance/case adjustment; source/protocol published before registered checks. Early unmetered development is recorded separately and not assigned zero cost.
